issue.title: ITK install fails if hdf5 is installed.

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

repository.name: vcpkg
repository.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

issue.body:
I found I couldn't install ITK on Windows 10 if VTK has already been installed. Seems to be down to the hdf5 dependency, it's mentioned in the [comments ](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/blob/47f362db993e31588f72f08e2982b04ae924430c/ports/itk/portfile.cmake#L42)of the ITK portfile.

Windows 10, Version 1709.
The steps to reproduce: vcpkg install vtk, [~~add disable_parallel_configure~~]( https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/issues/3115#issuecomment-399488948) vcpkg install itk
OR more specifically: vcpkg install hdf5[cpp], [~~add disable_parallel_configure~~]( https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/issues/3115#issuecomment-399488948) vcpkg install itk
The outcome you expected: Install successful
The actual outcome: **[BUILD_FAILED](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/2171436/output.txt)**
> -- Building x64-windows-dbg
> CMake Error at scripts/cmake/vcpkg_build_cmake.cmake:170 (message):
>     Command failed: C:/vcpkg/downloads/tools/cmake-3.11.4-windows/cmake-3.11.4-win32-x86/bin/cmake.exe;--build;.;--config;Debug;--target;install;--;-v;-j1
>     Working Directory: C:/vcpkg/buildtrees/itk/x64-windows-dbg
>     See logs for more information:
>       C:\vcpkg\buildtrees\itk\install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log


**[install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/2171438/install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log)**
> C:\vcpkg\installed\x64-windows\include\H5Tpkg.h(23): fatal error C1189: #error:  "Do not include this file outside the H5T package!"

I tried specifying HDF5[cpp] as a [build dependency](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/pull/3425/commits/ed9357a5aafea7192932b5874264bd103fc61255) for ITK. [BUILD_FAILED](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/2173210/output2.txt), problems with the hdf5-static target.  [install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/2173209/install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log). Adding a [patch](https://github.com/MarkIanHolland/vcpkg/blob/ITK/ports/itk/find-hdf5.patch) to help find the targets seemed to work for me, but only occasionally.

body: Adding DISABLE_PARALLEL_CONFIGURE to vcpkg_configure_cmake macro in portfile.cmake also fixes this issue for me. Should we make this the default for the ITK portfile?
I believe this is an acceptable fix to this problem.

body: I opened PR #3896 for this issue.

There seem to be two issues here.
The bigger issue is #3867 ; ITK would ideally use HDF5 from vcpkg. This is for consistency with other consumers of HDF5 and because currently ITK fails if a seemingly unrelated package (vcpkg's HDF5) is installed.
I merged #3896 to fix the parallel configure issue, to at least fix ITK-when-hdf5-is-not-installed.

issue.title: Update HDF5 to 1.10.2 or later

issue.body: This version introduces the ability to write backwards compatible files, which is required by ITK. See discussion [here](https://discourse.itk.org/t/updating-itks-hdf5/472/48?u=dzenanz). Might put to rest #3867 and #3115, given #5115.
